# The Institution Hidden Inside the Contract — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-loc-ppmsca-44953
Voiceover: The sheet demonstrates a contract-shaped network of design, printing, manufacture, advertising, attribution, and distribution—even when the operative agreements are absent from the image.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division

Rights: Free to Use and Reuse / Library of Congress curated set

### 8–16s — CO07-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · BEFORE — What enters the relationship?. Define parties, authority to sign, pre-existing materials, references, confidential inputs, third-party components, permissions, territory, intended channels, and the difference between background assets and new deliverables.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CO07-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · DURING — How does work move?. Specify deliverables, milestones, dependencies, review windows, named approvers, revision rounds, acceptance, change control, credit, documentation, source-file delivery, accessibility, and rights evidence. The schedule is a governance map.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CO07-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · CONTROL — Who may do what with the result?. Separate ownership from license; identify exclusivity, fields of use, territory, term, sublicensing, modification, archive, publicity, moral-rights issues where applicable, and statutory work-made-for-hire or transfer requirements.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CO07-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · AFTER — What survives change?. Map payment on termination, kill fees, return or deletion, archive copy, confidentiality, transition help, continuing licenses, credit correction, takedown, dispute procedure, and who retains the evidence needed to enforce or explain the deal.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S50
Voiceover: Amended and Restated Employment Agreement between Ralph Lauren Corporation and Ralph Lauren is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
